capabilities: Render Jira issue details in notes via jira-issue blocks and inline issue tags
Run Jira searches from notes with jira-search and jira-count blocks
Store Jira credentials in the OS keychain or encrypt them with a master passphrase
Switch between Modern and Classic render styles and configure widths and overflow animation
Resolve Epic Link and Parent fields across legacy Jira Server and modern Jira Cloud
extras: Documentation is partially behind external 'Read more...' links; some features (overflow animation) are disabled by default. Fork maintained by the community after the original author.
intentEvidence: It is now actively maintained and updated by the Obsidian-jira-plugin community team.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to view live Jira issue status or run Jira searches inside notes, forcing users to check Jira separately.

relations.evidence: This plugin was originally created and maintained by @marc0l92
track the progress of Atlassian Jira issues from your Obsidian.md notes

summary: Jira integration that renders and tracks the progress of Atlassian Jira issues and searches inline in notes via jira-issue, jira-search, and jira-count blocks.
